command_exit_codes.cmd: python -c "import json,pathlib,hashlib;P=pathlib.Path;sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(P(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest();S=json.loads(P('.workforce/loop-state.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));b=next(b for b in S['batches'] if b['id']=='B-AUD-3' and b.get('handoffs',{}).get('C-AUD-PROXY',{}).get('handoff_id')=='de96c50dc2d523aa5117e27e');h=b['handoffs']['C-AUD-PROXY'];dev='.workforce/evidence/B-AUD-3/dev-C-AUD-PROXY.json';qa='.workforce/evidence/B-AUD-3/qa-C-AUD-PROXY.json';assert sha(dev)==h['receipt_sha256']=='aa506984727bdc18f001b73e44b5e6c1ac578b0a35eb7d73aab025da440bcc8c';assert sha(qa)=='701ff09f90fbb793401e662315dc408c9cda2c96c6741b2e9ae8b1310586d6bf';drift=[f for f,s in h['files'].items() if sha(f)!=s];assert not drift,drift;print(json.dumps({'batch_base':b['batch_base'],'handoff_id':h['handoff_id'],'handoff_at':h['at'],'dev_receipt_sha256':sha(dev),'qa_receipt_sha256':sha(qa),'frozen_files_total':len(h['files']),'drift':drift},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))"

python -c "import json,pathlib,re;P=pathlib.Path;L=json.loads(P('tests/hotspot_ledger.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));raw=lambda f:P(f).read_bytes().decode('utf-8');N=lambda f:len(raw(f).splitlines());T=L['threshold'];B=L['baseline_lines'];A=L['adjustments'];files=sorted(p.as_posix() for p in P('src').rglob('*.rs'));counts={f:N(f) for f in files};assert type(T) is int and T==500;assert all(type(v) is int and v>=T for v in B.values());assert set(B)=={f for f,n in counts.items() if n>=T};badbase={f:(B[f],counts.get(f)) for f in B if counts.get(f)!=B[f]};assert not badbase,badbase;R=['file','old','new','reason','authorized_by','date'];missing=[(i,k) for i,a in enumerate(A) for k in R if k not in a or a[k] in (None,'')];assert not missing,missing;chains={f:[(i,a) for i,a in enumerate(A) if a['file']==f] for f in B};gaps=[(f,chains[f][i-1][1]['new'],chains[f][i][1]['old']) for f in B for i in range(1,len(chains[f])) if chains[f][i][1]['old']!=chains[f][i-1][1]['new']];badend={f:(chains[f][-1][1]['new'],B[f]) for f in B if chains[f][-1][1]['new']!=B[f]};assert not gaps and not badend,(gaps,badend);assert set(a['file'] for a in A)<=set(B);special=set(map(chr,[11,12,28,29,30,133,8232,8233]));metric=[f for f in files if special.intersection(raw(f)) or re.search(r'\r(?!\n)',raw(f))];assert not metric,metric;print(json.dumps({'threshold':T,'src_rs_files_total':len(files),'files_ge_threshold':len(B),'baseline_eq_measured':len(B),'unlisted_oversized':[],'adjustments_total':len(A),'six_fields_ok':len(A),'chain_gaps':gaps,'non_converged':badend,'chains':{f:{'entries':len(aa),'first_old':aa[0][1]['old'],'last_new':aa[-1][1]['new'],'baseline':B[f]} for f,aa in chains.items()},'line_metric_equivalent':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))"
